This plot is small, only a small piece near the house, but maize is what feeds my family so I give it my attention. I have some manure from my oxen and goats, and I will carry it to the plot before the rains — this is what my father did and what I know works. For fertilizer from the cooperative, I will try to get a small share of DAP if the cooperative brings it in time, but urea costs too much for this little plot so I will use only a little. I keep my own seed from last harvest like my neighbors, and I do not spray anything — I just weed with my hoe and my wife helps.
